title: Minimality and local dimension of a quotient prime
statement: For the powered parameter ideal J and a prime q whose localized maximal ideal is generated by the variable images, every quotient prime q₀ contracting to q has localization of dimension zero. For every quotient algebra map γ₀, if its extended singular ideal is contained in q₀, then q₀ is minimal over that ideal. This holds for every c≥0 and requires no regularity or separability.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07FE (lemma-resolve-special), final powered-parameter reduction

proof.text: Let P be a prime of Λ/JΛ below q₀ and p its contraction to Λ. Then p≤q and p contains all powered parameter images. Primality gives the parameter images themselves in p. In Λ_q their span is the maximal ideal, so pΛ_q equals the maximal ideal. Contracting back proves p=q, and injectivity of quotient contraction proves P=q₀. Thus q₀ is a minimal prime.

Mathlib Ring.KrullDimLE.of_isLocalization gives dimension at most zero for the localization at this minimal prime. This local ring is nontrivial, so its dimension is exactly zero. The same absence of any smaller prime proves minimality over every ideal contained in q₀, including the extended singular ideal. For d=0 the generation hypothesis says Λ_q is a field; for c=0 and d>0 there is no quotient prime.

theorem parameter_quotient_prime_geometry
    {k : Type u} {C : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing C] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    (d c : ℕ) (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C]
    [FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦
      algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (φ (MvPolynomial.X i)))) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) :
    letI := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    let J : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) :=
      Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦ (MvPolynomial.X i ^ c) ^ 8))
    let J_C := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) C) J
    let J_Λ := Ideal.map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) Λ) J
    ∀ (_ : FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J) (C ⧸ J_C))
      (γ₀ : (C ⧸ J_C) →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin d) k ⧸ J] (Λ ⧸ J_Λ))
      (q₀ : PrimeSpectrum (Λ ⧸ J_Λ)),
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk J_Λ) q₀ = q →
      ringKrullDim (Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal) = 0 ∧
      (popescuIdeal γ₀ ≤ q₀.asIdeal → q₀.asIdeal ∈ (popescuIdeal γ₀).minimalPrimes)
